description: Edit one triageEvalCases entry in place — only the fields you provide change. Use to fix a case's ticket text, expected classification, expected owning team, or metadata. To update many cases at once, prefer anyforge_upsert_triage_eval_cases (pass each case's id). Requires `write` scope.

caseId.description: The eval case id to update.

expectedAction.description: Optional exact recommended-action text to score; this never executes an action.

expectedRepoFullName.description: Optional owner/name repository prediction to score.

expectedTeamId.description: Set to also score routing accuracy.

asOf.description: Absolute UTC evidence cutoff for this case.

snapshotIds.description: Immutable IDs returned when supplied evidence was saved.

input.description: The ticket description this case classifies.

name: anyforge_update_triage_eval_case
title: Update triage eval case
